name: print-social-black-event-schedule-poster-with-orange-headline-and-ruled-rows
title: Black 'Event Schedule April — May' poster with orange headline and ruled rows of dates
whatItIs: A portrait black poster with a huge orange uppercase 'EVENT SCHEDULE', a white 'April — May' subhead and six ruled rows each pairing a bold uppercase session title, a large date and time (25.04 14:00) and a small orange category with a description, plus a contact footer.
whatItMeans: Clear and confident; ruled rows turn a schedule into a typographic poster.
techniques: Set a schedule as ruled table rows.
Give dates big numerals as a column.
Colour only the headline and category labels.
Keep everything on one strong grid.

vocabulary.definition: Content aligned in columns like a table.
